scope: Anonymous calculation-only MCP. Place inputs follow the per-tool `place` policy: `user` (birthplace or specified event place, city-level, required), `user_optional` (birthplace only affects true solar time; omitted = clock time), `client` (the chart is for here-and-now; the place comes only from the client's coarse location hint), `none` (no place is used). Directory review of these inputs is not certified by engineering checks.

limits.max_output_bytes_scope: Serialized MCP CallToolResult UTF-8 bytes, including content and structuredContent, excluding outer JSON-RPC framing.

output_measurement.status: fixture replay measured; full Linux live matrix pending P2
output_measurement.basis: Eight repository golden/recorded snapshot samples; includes two MCP copies and JSON quoting. This is not an all-tool maximum or directory compliance approval.
output_measurement.cap_rationale: 64 KiB limits anonymous response load, leaves room above the recorded sample maximum, and truncates larger results with a warning.

place_policies.user: Birthplace or specified event place supplied by the user at city-level precision; coordinates are rounded to 0.01°.
place_policies.user_optional: Birthplace (or place of the question when `client_hint` is true) is optional and only affects true solar time; when omitted the calculation uses clock time. A birthplace is never taken from the client's location hint.
place_policies.client: No place input. The client's coarse location hint (_meta openai/userLocation) is used when present.
place_policies.none: No place is used by the calculation.

place_fallbacks.clock_time: Without a place: force timeAlg=1 (clock time), synthesize the timezone meridian, strip place echoes, warn.
place_fallbacks.required: Without a place the tool returns public.location_unavailable and runs nothing.
place_fallbacks.ignore: Without a place: synthesize the timezone meridian silently (the value cannot change the result).
